content_strategy.primary_goal: Generate awareness, credibility, engagement, and potential business leads for Vahvero Symbiosis and its software and data solutions.
content_strategy.positioning_goal: Position Vahvero as a knowledgeable and reliable Finnish software and data engineering company.
content_mix: Occasional light or humorous technology posts
lead_generation_focus: Organizations that may need healthcare software
European organizations that may benefit from Raiqu

post_structure: Start with a strong but natural hook.
Explain the problem, question, or topic clearly.
Connect the topic to Vahvero, Raiqu, or company expertise only when relevant.
Use a clear call to action when appropriate.

rules: Use a CTA only when it is relevant to the post.
When a business contact CTA is appropriate, prefer contact@vahvero.fi.
When a website link is appropriate, prefer www.vahvero.com.

language_rules.rule: When Finnish content is requested, produce a natural Finnish version. For normal LinkedIn publishing, English is the main post language and Finnish may be used separately when appropriate.

formatting_rules: Use a small number of highly relevant hashtags.
Use Unicode bold only for short important phrases when appropriate.
Keep formatting clean and suitable for LinkedIn.
content_rules: Do not present Raiqu as replacing healthcare professionals.
Clearly distinguish product capabilities from general industry information.
humor_rules: Light professional humor is allowed when appropriate.
Humor should connect to a real technical or business insight.
Humor must not undermine the company's professional image.
post_rules: Keep posts relevant to Vahvero's business or target audience.
Prefer useful and educational content over generic promotional content.
Do not force a Vahvero connection when the topic does not naturally support one.
Avoid repeating previously approved topics and angles when possible.
